items.item: Runs or asks for an automation inventory of the existing flows, triggers, workflow rules and process builders on Opportunity and Account before choosing an approach
items.evidence: The conflict check is step 3, after the approach is chosen: "Check for conflicts. Look in `uat` for existing Account or Opportunity automation...". The repo claim "There are no triggers or flows on Opportunity" is not an org inventory, and the answer says "I haven't queried `uat`".

items.item: Chooses an after-save record-triggered flow (or Apex), not a before-save flow, because it updates a different record
items.evidence: It chooses "record-triggered Flow (after save)", but never says that this is because it updates a different record (Account), and never contrasts it with before-save.

items.item: Limits the entry condition to the change to Closed Won (for example ISCHANGED or "only when a record is updated to meet the condition")
items.evidence: "Run only when the record is created or updated to meet the condition. This fires only on the transition into Won, not on every later edit."

items.item: Mentions bulk behaviour (many Opportunities saved at once) or recursion and order of execution
items.evidence: "Multiple wins in one transaction | Flow bulkifies this." and "Bulk: update about 200 Opportunities across about 50 Accounts"
